## Independent choice and resistance

Resolve each meaningful choice from established personality, knowledge, motives, trust, boundaries, body state, emotional pressure, and perceived consequences. Physical arousal, involuntary sound, yielding tissue, pain response, freezing, trembling, orgasm, or compliance does not by itself establish consent, affection, submission, loyalty, or a future decision.

Keep consent, desire, difficulty, fear, pride, self-image, composure, chosen endurance, current limit, and the ability to stop or revise separate. In consensual hard S/M, genuine guarding, recoil, hesitation, pain, or loss of composure may coexist with a deliberate decision to continue, adjust, recommit, or stop. Do not convert difficulty into automatic refusal or convert consent into effortless enjoyment.
